title: Route-and-Model Failure Profiles + Trend Dashboard
creator: Leah Chen
description: Create a consolidated dashboard and canonical failure-profile taxonomy targeted at SREs and platform engineers. The goal is to surface correlated failure signatures by route, model version, and region and enable fast triage for timeouts, overloads, model errors (decode/runtime), and transport codes (HTTP/gRPC). This ticket covers: (1) dashboard panels and drilldowns, (2) derived metrics and labels to attach in the metric/log pipeline, (3) tracing hook additions to capture route/model context and failure classification, and (4) migration plan for existing dashboards to the new taxonomy without breaking alerting.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows per-route and per-model failure-rate heatmap (7d/24h) with top 5 correlated dimensions: region, model_version, backend_latency_bucket, request_size_bucket, and caller_service
Failure taxonomy implemented as a classifier tag in traces/metrics with values: timeout, overload, model_error, invalid_input, transport_error, auth_failure, infra_error
Panels for percentiles (p50/p95/p99) of end-to-end latency split by failure type and by route
Drilldown links to trace ID, raw logs, and GitHub-linked incident when error spike originates from release rollout
Migration plan documented and feature-flagged; existing alerts adapted to new taxonomy with no more than one scheduled alert change outage window
Performance cost estimate for added tracing attributes stays below 5% ingestion increase on active routes
comments: 2025-02-19: Kickoff — aligned with SRE and runtime teams on the need to standardize on taxonomy values and the label naming convention (obs.failure_type). Agreed to keep taxonomy flat strings to avoid cardinality explosion.

2025-02-25: Trade-off discussion — two options: (A) enrich existing span tags (low lift) vs (B) emit separate derived metrics with normalized failure buckets (better query performance). Decided to implement both: span tag immediately + nightly job to aggregate metrics for dashboards.

2025-03-01: PR opened for tracing hook (platform/trace-enricher): https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3912 — adds route_id and model_version to root span and applies failure classifier based on transport codes and exception type.
2025-03-03: UX review with PM Ingrid — added a compact sparklines row for historical trend and an embedding of recent alerting incidents. PM requested an extra panel for slow-model rollouts.

2025-03-05: Observability infra note — pipeline change required in metrics ingestion to accept obs.failure_type tag on counts/latency histograms. Ops requested a canary timeframe and retention estimates; estimated 4% extra cardinality for top 50 routes.

2025-03-06: Work in progress — dashboard skeleton in Grafana created, sample panels rendered against persisted nightly aggregates. Need backend to populate normalized metrics for high-cardinality routes. Next: coordinate with metrics-team to add aggregation job and add feature flag for rollout.
Follow-ups: post-deploy runbook, owner for alert changes (SRE team), and a short training doc for on-call responders.
